sq.QUESTION_DESC: Describe the process flow of collecting user input using a Swing form.

lq.ANSWER:
import javax.swing.*;
import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;

public class StudentForm extends JFrame {
    public StudentForm() {
        setTitle("Student Info Form");
        setLayout(new GridLayout(4, 2, 10, 10));
        setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
        setSize(350, 200);

        JLabel nameLabel = new JLabel("Name:");
        JTextField nameField = new JTextField();

        JLabel ageLabel = new JLabel("Age:");
        JTextField ageField = new JTextField();

        JLabel deptLabel = new JLabel("Department:");
        JTextField deptField = new JTextField();

        JButton submitButton = new JButton("Submit");

        add(nameLabel); add(nameField);
        add(ageLabel); add(ageField);
        add(deptLabel); add(deptField);
        add(new JLabel()); add(submitButton);

        submitButton.addActionListener(new ActionListener() {
            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
                String name = nameField.getText();
                String age = ageField.getText();
                String dept = deptField.getText();

                if (name.isEmpty() || age.isEmpty() || dept.isEmpty()) {
                    JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, "Please fill all fields.");
                } else {
                    JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null,
                        "Student Info:\nName: " + name + "\nAge: " + age + "\nDepartment: " + dept);
                }
            }
        });

        setVisible(true);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new StudentForm();
    }
}
